correctness.rationale: The original conv of 3m+1 ordered star incidence pairs is exactly the positive leaf cone with sum_i max(u_i,v_i)<=1, because each leaf pair decomposes into three vertex contributions. Its 2m coordinate and 2^m upper inequalities are all facet-defining. Projecting normals into the true two-block sum-zero affine tangent space gives coordinate norm a=sqrt(m/(m+1)) and upper norm sqrt((m+2s(m-s))/(m+1)). Permutations and block-swap average any maximizing ball to uniform leaves t; balancing the two sharp facet distances gives r=1/(ma+b), t=ar. The lower bounds plus every balanced upper inequality force each leaf variable to t, proving uniqueness, including m=1. Numerical unrestricted-center LP checks independently reproduced m=1..9.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Davis–Chen forest formulas and Ohsugi–Tsuchiya join formulas analyze normalized volumes or h*; the closely related same-star Löwner result is OUTWARD. None of these is a stronger theorem implying the inward unique-center and tangent facets.

originality.rationale: Existing PQ adjacency-polytope papers focus on volume and Ehrhart h* geometry, while the earlier symmetric-edge star and cosmological star inball results concern different convex hulls and metric realizations. The later same-star PQ Löwner-ellipsoid record studies an enclosing rather than inscribed ellipsoid. A matching direct source is the assigned Resultary record itself. Complete exact inward inradius, unique incenter and facet-contact classes are best-of-knowledge novel.
